FAQ

Are gifts expected?
No gifts please — your blessings for the couple are all that is asked.
What should I wear?
As the ceremony takes place at the ISKCON New Vrindaban temple, modest, traditional attire is appreciated.
Is there a schedule for both days?
Yes — see the Schedule section above for the full timing of the Sangeet on September 20th and the wedding ceremony on September 21st.
Where should I stay?
Check-in and check-out details are listed in the Accommodation section.
Who can I contact for more information?
Prabhudev: 647-637-2581 and/or Abhishek: 647-467-2204
